_comment: Defaults for the monthly post, loaded by publisher/. Committed to the repo so the template survives a cleared cache and works on any machine. The dashboard's 'Save for this browser' button stores a per-device override in localStorage that wins over this file; 'Download for repo' writes this file back out so a change can be committed.
